answer.reason: Shittim is where Israel fell into the worship of Baalpeor and where Joshua sent out the two spies.

clauses.english: was where Israel joined himself to Baalpeor and the LORD's anger was kindled
clauses.quote: Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled

clauses.english: was where Joshua sent out two men to spy out Jericho
clauses.quote: Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly

doubts: HOS 5:2 is marked but does not name Shittim in this text, so it was left out.
JOL 3:18 is a prophecy of a future watering of the valley, not an event, so it was left out.
MIC 6:5 only mentions Balaam's answer from Shittim to Gilgal, which is too slight to cite.
The move from Shittim to Jordan (JOS 3:1) is already in the summary.
